content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Virginia Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional years in role. Review PMI's specific hour and education thresholds before applying. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your qualifications and identify any gaps.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions synchronously with active certified practitioners who guide you through the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Earn your completion certificate upon attendance.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP credential application directly with PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee during registration. Granite PM Academy can walk you through the application steps to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the four-hour, 180-question assessment on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or leading projects. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting your PDU hours and renewal fee to PMI.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
